metadata.title: fix(rbac): resolve SSO role assignment FK constraint violation on granted_by='sso_system'
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Adds `grant_source` column to `UserRole` model to track role assignment provenance (`"sso"`, `"manual"`, `"bootstrap"`, etc.) separately from the `granted_by` FK column
- SSO role sync now uses `granted_by=user_email` (self-grant, satisfying the FK to `email_users`) with `grant_source="sso"` to distinguish SSO-granted roles
- Fixes the `ForeignKeyViolation` that occurred because `granted_by="sso_system"` referenced a non-existent user in `email_users`
- Includes idempotent Alembic migration, regression tests, and documentation updates

Closes #3484

## Test plan

- [x] 372 affected tests pass (role service, SSO service, SSO Entra role mapping, migrations, bootstrap)
- [x] 13,372 full unit test suite passes (0 failures)
- [x] Regression test: `test_sync_user_roles_uses_user_email_as_granted_by` verifies FK constraint is satisfied
- [x] Regression test: `test_sync_user_roles_does_not_revoke_non_sso_self_granted_roles` verifies non-SSO roles survive sync
- [x] PostgreSQL live validation: old approach triggers `ForeignKeyViolation`, new approach succeeds
- [x] Migration verified on running SSO compose stack — `grant_source` column created automatically
- [x] `make interrogate` passes at 100%

commits.message:
fix(rbac): resolve SSO role assignment FK constraint violation on granted_by='sso_system' (#3484)

Add grant_source column to UserRole to track role assignment provenance
(e.g. 'sso', 'manual', 'bootstrap') separately from the granted_by FK.
SSO role sync now uses granted_by=user_email (satisfying the FK to
email_users) with grant_source='sso' to distinguish SSO-granted roles
for revocation logic.

Closes #3484

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(sso): rewrite Keycloak issuer URL to public_base_url for id_token verification

Keycloak discovery fetches OIDC metadata via the internal base_url
(e.g. http://keycloak:8080), but tokens issued through the browser flow
contain the public-facing issuer (e.g. http://localhost:8180). The
authorization_url was already rewritten to public_base_url but the
issuer was not, causing id_token verification to fail with
"Invalid issuer".

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

fix(rbac): expose grant_source in UserRoleResponse API schema
